name: Multiverse Computing
description: Multiverse Computing provides quantum AI software for enterprise applications, specializing in optimization and machine learning. Their flagship product Singularity enables model compression and quantum-inspired algorithms for finance, energy, and manufacturing sectors.
funding: USD 570M Series C (July 2026, $1.7B pre-money valuation); total funding ~USD 800M

products.description: Quantum AI platform for model compression, optimization, and quantum-inspired machine learning at enterprise scale

news.title: Multiverse Computing Announces a $70 Million Investment From The Spanish government
news.excerpt: Spain's government will become a shareholder in Multiverse Computing with a co-investment of €67 million through the Spanish Society for Technological Transformation (SETT) to advance energy-efficient AI language models.

news.title: Multiverse Computing raises $215M for tech that could radically lower AI costs
news.excerpt: Spanish startup Multiverse Computing raised an enormous Series B round of €189 million (about $215 million) on the strength of its CompactifAI compression technology.

news.title: AI model compression startup Multiverse seeking €500M funding round
news.excerpt: Multiverse Computing is reportedly seeking €500 million in new capital, with the round expected to value the company at €1.5 billion.

news.title: HyperNova 60B, the world's most efficient model in its category according to Artificial Analysis
news.excerpt: Multiverse Computing's model has been independently validated and ranks as the one that best combines high intelligence with a compact parameter footprint among models of its size.

news.title: Multiverse Computing releases free compressed HyperNova 60B AI model
news.excerpt: Spanish 'soonicorn' ships CompactifAI-compressed HyperNova 60B on Hugging Face amid reports of a €500M round at a €1.5B valuation.

news.title: Multiverse Computing Announces $570M Series C at $1.7B Valuation
news.excerpt: Multiverse Computing announced a Series C targeting up to $570M at a $1.7B pre-money valuation, co-led by Forgepoint Capital International, BNPP Solar Impulse Venture Fund, and Bullhound Capital. The company reported 10x annualized revenue growth since Series B and 96x YoY sales growth in Q1 2026.
